subject: Request: mid-year retention & pro-rated merit for Senior Platform Engineer (Anika Desai)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: mid-year retention & pro-rated merit for Senior Platform Engineer (Anika Desai)

Team —

Heads up: Anika Desai (Senior Platform Engineer, Infra) shared a verbal counteroffer from a competitor this morning; they requested 2 weeks to respond. Anika has been on an extended high-impact track (led the KV cache rewrite + onboarding for Dedicated customers) and was flagged during the last calibration as a high-performer but outside the timing window for the scheduled end-of-year merit cycle.

As discussed in my 1:1 with Vivek, I want to propose a short retention package that we can quickly approve if the Compensation Committee is comfortable:
- Pro-rated merit increase (6 months worth at the target meriting percentile) effective immediately (pro-rated to start date),
- One-time cash retention bonus: $12,000
- Equity refresh: grant equivalent to a 15% uplift on annualized RSUs (one-time grant, subject to standard vesting)

Why urgent: losing Anika right now would create a product deliverables risk for our Dedicated rollout and add ~0.6 FTE hiring cost + ramp. We have the headcount and funding in the Q4 bench; I attached an excerpt of their recent performance highlights and a manager justification draft.

Asks:
1) Marissa — can you confirm comp policy constraints and whether a one-off equity refresh of this shape is permissible outside the cycle?
2) Laura — please confirm if we can fund the proposed cash + comp from the existing HW/Platform budget (see quick pro-forma attached).
3) Vivek/Jordan — please reply with your endorsement so I can consolidate for Marissa/Comp Committee.

Attachments: anika_perf_excerpt.pdf; manager_justification.docx; comp-pro-forma-2026Q4.xlsx

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering (Americas)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: mid-year retention & pro-rated merit for Senior Platform Engineer (Anika Desai)

Grace —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick notes from Comp: we can consider an off-cycle one-time equity refresh for retention but need the following before I can route to the Compensation Committee:
- Manager justification that ties the grant size to role scope + market delta (attach to the approval packet),
- Confirmation that Anika is not currently in any performance improvement plan or under conduct review (confirm),
- Proposed grant type (RSU vs. performance-restricted units) and suggested vesting schedule, and
- Pro-forma fully loaded cost (salary + bonus + equity uplift) and headcount accounting code.

If you can send the manager_justification.docx filled and the cost sheet populated I can fast-track the packet. For the cash bonus amount, $12k is within typical ad-hoc retention ranges for senior ICs; we may ask the committee to consider $10–15k band.

I'll ping CompOps (copying compops@benchmarking.ai) for market reference if helpful.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: mid-year retention & pro-rated merit for Senior Platform Engineer (Anika Desai)

Quick endorsement from me.

Summary rationale:
- Anika is a critical contributor to the Dedicated launch and has been the go-to on our KV/inference caching optimizations.
- Replacement risk is high (specialized infra knowledge + ramp to ownership ~= 6 months).
- Losing them would delay key deliverables for Q1.

I support the package outlined by Grace (6-month pro-rated merit, $12k one-time, 15% equity uplift) with standard vesting (25% after 1 year, then quarterly over remaining 3 years). If Comp prefers PRUs for retention alignment, I'm open to that.

Please let me know if you need a short note I can sign-off on for the packet; I can also join the committee call if helpful.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: mid-year retention & pro-rated merit for Senior Platform Engineer (Anika Desai)

Grace —

I've reviewed the pro-forma you attached. High-level finance position: we have the headroom in the Platform FY2026 Q4 contingency to cover the $12k cash payment this quarter and absorb the pro-rated merit impact for the remainder of the year. The equity uplift will create a $XXk grant accounting impact against FY26 headcount expense; nominally fine but we need it logged to GL code 6321 and approval from Comp Committee for capital planning.

Please:
- Update the comp-pro-forma-2026Q4.xlsx to include GL code 6321 and the charged org (Platform Eng) — I added comments in column H.
- Confirm whether the proposed RSU uplift should be treated as a one-time refresh or a restructured grant (affects expensing schedule).

Once Marissa confirms policy eligibility and the manager justification is attached, finance can sign off and I will route to accounting to book the accrual.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: mid-year retention & pro-rated merit for Senior Platform Engineer (Anika Desai)

+1 from me — I approve the proposed package.

If Comp Committee needs a second business case note, I can provide brief comments on customer impact and product timelines.

Please mark this APPROVE so we can get Marsh (Comp Admin) to queue the packet today.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
